title: LEMR-Automation-Bias: Learning EMR fork for the automation-bias study
description: Django prototype of a Learning Electronic Medical Record (LEMR) system, extended with study-specific instrumentation for a within-participant automation-bias evaluation with ICU physicians. Fork of ajk77/LEMRinterface (Andrew J. King, 2018), retaining GPL-3.0. Companion software to Calzoni (2026) PhD dissertation, University of Pittsburgh. See CHANGES_FROM_KING.md for the full inventory of study-specific modifications.
notes: The pickled patient-case data used in the original evaluation study cannot be redistributed and is not included in this release. The upstream King repository (ajk77/LEMRinterface) ships three synthetic demo cases under resources/demo_study/ that can be used to exercise the interface.
